headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 22, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up, with several teams securing crucial wins and others facing setbacks due to injuries. Here's a summary of the top news, injuries, and roster movements from the past day.

Top News
The Kansas City Royals edged the Tampa Bay Rays 2-1, with Michael Wacha earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. The Texas Rangers secured a narrow win over the Miami Marlins, with Ezequiel Duran leading the Rangers' offense with a home run and two RBIs. The Washington Nationals took down the Philadelphia Phillies 4-1, with Foster Griffin pitching 7.1 innings and allowing just 1 earned run. The New York Yankees suffered a 3-5 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Amed Rosario leading the Yankees' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

Injuries and Availability Impact
Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Kansas City Royals third baseman Maikel Garcia, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hand muscle strain. Detroit Tigers right-hander Burch Smith has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño, Miami Marlins right-hander Josh Ekness, Miami Marlins catcher Liam Hicks, Athletics right-hander Luis Severino, Texas Rangers right-hander Jack Leiter, and Baltimore Orioles catcher Adley Rutschman.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Houston Astros have bolstered their roster with the addition of shortstop Marcus Brown, acquired from the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash. The Washington Nationals traded shortstop Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded right-hander Tyler Schoff to the Washington Nationals. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-hander Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded shortstop Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves traded right-hander Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for catcher Joey Bart.
